summary: Aircraft on stands 12, 19, 21 or 25 at EGNT must follow marshaller instructions, as apron line markings are not yet on charts.
text:
ACFT ALLOCATED TO STANDS 12, 19, 21 OR 25 SHALL FOLLOW MARSHALLER
INSTRUCTIONS AT ALL TIMES. FOLLOW ME AVBL ON REQ DUE APRON LINE 
MARKING CHANGES NOT YET APPLIED TO ACFT GROUND 
MOVEMENT/PARKING/DOCKING CHART.
